terms.noneActive: No custom terms; plan terms apply.

change.previewRejected: The server returned a preview, which cannot be ordered. Try again.
change.onBehalf: You are making this change on the customer's behalf.
change.pendingOrder: This subscription has a pending order. Review its status on the customer page before placing another order.
change.firstOnBehalf: You are placing the customer's first order on their behalf. The customer pays by bank transfer or payment link, or nothing is due when the plan is free.
change.bundlesHint: The plan's included bundles come with it; tick the optional ones the customer buys.

suspension.suspendHint: Every user of the workspace is refused at sign-in with the suspension message. Data is kept, and a payment does not lift a suspension ordered here; only resuming from here does.
suspension.resumeHint: The workspace users can work again. If an invoice is overdue, a fresh grace period starts before collection can stop it again.
suspension.suspendedNotice: The subscription is suspended: workspace users cannot sign in.

cardActions.removeHint: The card is deleted at the payment provider and automatic renewal stops. The customer pays the next invoice by hand and can save a new card then.
cardActions.disableAutoRenewHint: The card stays on file but nothing is charged to it automatically. The customer pays the next invoice by hand and can turn automatic renewal on again.

errors.provider_unavailable: The payment provider could not delete the card now. The card was NOT removed and automatic renewal is unchanged. Try again later.
errors.provider_mismatch: This card belongs to another payment provider mode and cannot be removed here.

renewalCancel.cancelTitle: Cancel the renewal on the customer's behalf?
renewalCancel.cancelHint: The customer keeps the paid period until the renewal date, then drops to the free base. Nothing is deleted and no refund is made. The customer can resume before that date. They receive an email.
renewalCancel.resumeHint: The subscription renews on its renewal date as usual. The customer receives an email.

errors.nothing_to_cancel: The plan has nothing paid to cancel.
errors.subscription_past_due: An invoice is overdue. Collect it first.
errors.lock_pending: A change to the free base is being applied. Try again later.
errors.subscription_change_pending: A change is still being processed.
errors.cancel_already_effective: The period has ended; the cancellation can no longer be withdrawn.

adminLogin.title: Address on record
adminLogin.hint: Every message the control plane sends for this workspace goes to this address: the invitation, subscription billing, trial and cancellation notices and the workspace deletion code.
adminLogin.consequence: The new address receives all control-plane mail from now on, queued mail included, and both the old and the new address are told. Unused invitations to the old address stop working and a pending deletion code is cancelled. No account, password or login inside the workspace changes: the new person must already have an account there.

errors.admin_login_unchanged: This is already the address on record.
errors.no_workspace: This customer has no workspace yet.
errors.workspace_not_activated: No manager has activated this workspace yet, so its address was fixed at provisioning and cannot be changed. Create the customer again with the right address, or wait for the rename action.

adminLogin.changed: The address was changed. No account in the workspace was touched. Both addresses were told.
adminLogin.shared: {count} other customer(s) already use this address. "Find my workspace" will list all their workspaces to that mailbox.

deletion.requested: Deletion requested on {requested}. Waiting for the customer to confirm with the emailed code.
deletion.confirmed: Deletion confirmed on {confirmed}. The workspace, its files and its backups are due to be deleted on {due}.
deletion.due: The withdrawal window ended on {due}. The request is in its final hold until {hold} and the workspace still works.
deletion.deleting: Access to the workspace has been stopped since {deleting} and the deletion is being carried out.
deletion.withdrawn: The deletion request was withdrawn. Access to the workspace, stopped since {deleting}, is being restored.

renewal.cancelled: The paid renewal was cancelled at the period end. No refund is made.
renewal.already_cancelled: The paid renewal was already cancelled.
renewal.not_cancellable: The paid renewal could not be cancelled automatically ({reason}). Stop it by hand if the customer pays.

refusals.nothing_to_cancel: the workspace is on the free base
refusals.lock_pending: a change to the free base is being applied
refusals.subscription_change_pending: a change is still being processed
refusals.subscription_required: the subscription has no applied plan

deletion.withdrawTitle: Withdraw the deletion request on the customer's behalf?
deletion.withdrawHint: The workspace is not deleted, and access is restored if it was stopped. A cancelled renewal is not resumed: the customer resumes it from the subscription page. The customer receives an email and so do you.

run.title: Deletion run
run.runnerOff: The deletion runner is off: it records its plan and carries nothing out.

runnerOffReasons.mail_host_unset: No mail host is configured, so no notice could be delivered.
runnerOffReasons.local_mail_capture: The mail host is a local capture (localhost or mailpit): a mail accepted there reaches no customer.

run.restoreHold: Restore hold: after a control plane restore no request leaves its final hold before this time.
run.notCommitted: The point of no return has not been passed: you can still withdraw the request.
run.committed: The point of no return has passed: the request can no longer be withdrawn.
run.noPlan: The plan is frozen when the hold ends.

codes.plan_digest_mismatch: The frozen plan does not match its digest
codes.plan_changed: The plan changed since it was frozen
codes.binding_changed: The workspace binding changed during deletion
codes.control_plane_restored: The control plane was restored and its restore hold applies
codes.hold_not_served: The final hold has not run its course
codes.last_call_delivered: The last-call notice has not reached the customer yet
codes.final_mail_pending: The final mail is still being sent
codes.final_mail_unsent: The final mail was not sent
codes.marker_missing_needs_operator: The workspace identity marker is missing and needs an operator
codes.step_failed: The step failed for an unspecified reason
codes.access_not_stopped: Access to the workspace was not stopped
codes.card_delete_failed: A saved card could not be deleted; it will be retried
codes.card_not_deleted: A saved card was not deleted
codes.not_committed: The point of no return has not been passed
codes.relay_not_configured: The TikTok relay is not configured
codes.kill_switch_off: The deletion kill switch is off
codes.deletion_lease_lost: The runner lost its lease on the deletion
codes.deletion_state_changed: The deletion request changed state while running
codes.deletion_authority_lost: The authority to run the deletion was lost
codes.authority_lost: The authority to run the deletion was lost
codes.offsite_not_empty: Off-site backups remain after the purge
codes.artifact_path_invalid: The backup file path is invalid
codes.artifact_root_unavailable: The backup file folder is unavailable
codes.database_filestore_mismatch: The database does not match the file folder
codes.database_blocklisted: The database is protected from deletion
codes.database_is_restore_copy: The database is listed as a restore copy
codes.database_is_control_plane: The database is the control plane database
codes.identity_query_failed: The workspace identity could not be read
codes.identity_base_url_mismatch: The workspace address does not match the plan
codes.identity_base_url_not_frozen: The workspace address is not frozen
codes.identity_profile_count: The number of workspace identity profiles is wrong
codes.identity_profile_mode: The workspace is not in SaaS mode
codes.identity_company_mismatch: The workspace company does not match the plan
codes.identity_marker_missing: The workspace identity marker is missing
codes.identity_marker_mismatch: The workspace identity marker does not match the customer
codes.restore_target_invalid: The restore copy target is invalid
codes.database_fence_unproven: Blocking connections to the database was not proven
codes.restore_copy_unreadable: The restore copy could not be read
codes.restore_copy_marker_missing: The restore copy identity marker is missing
codes.restore_copy_marker_mismatch: The restore copy identity marker does not match the customer
codes.database_fence_failed: Connections to the database could not be blocked
codes.database_drop_failed: The database could not be dropped
codes.database_still_present: The database is still present after the drop
codes.files_still_present: The files are still present after deletion
codes.path_symlink: The file path is a symbolic link
codes.remove_failed: The files could not be removed
codes.release_operation_blocked: The workspace release operation is blocked
codes.tenant_drop_failed: The workspace drop failed for an unclassified reason

checks.due_notice_delivered: The deletion due notice was delivered
checks.no_free_base_lock: No move to the free base is running
checks.no_payment_after_due: No payment came in after the deletion fell due

errors.deletion_in_progress: The deletion has passed its point of no return: the request can no longer be withdrawn.

cancelOrder.title: Cancel this unpaid order?
cancelOrder.description: The payment provider must confirm cancellation before you can choose another plan. Applied services stay as they are.
cancelOrder.refreshFailed: Subscription status could not be refreshed. Reload before trying again.

errors.order_not_cancellable: This order can no longer be cancelled. Review the current subscription status.
errors.payment_reconciliation_required: Payment reconciliation is required before cancellation. Check the payment status, then retry.
errors.provider_mismatch: This payment belongs to a different provider. Review the payment configuration before retrying.
errors.reason_required: Enter a cancellation reason between 3 and 1000 characters.

customers.noWorkspaceYet: No workspace has been set up yet
customers.noWorkspaceHint: The workspace is created once the subscription is activated. Provisioning and operations show here then.
customers.changeBlocked: The subscription cannot be changed while an order is pending. Finish or cancel the order first.

glance.unreadable: Workspace state could not be read
glance.unreadableHint: Open issues may be missing. Retry to check again.

issues.setup: This customer has no commercial plan yet.
issues.orderFailed: The pending order failed and needs review.
issues.stalled: Order activation has been stalled for more than 24 hours.
issues.operation: A recent operation on the workspace failed.

history.title: Subscription stages
history.hint: Newest first, as recorded by the control plane.
history.whoHint: Who made each change, and why, is in the audit log.

newPage.noRelease: There is no applications release yet.
newPage.noReleaseHint: Publish an applications release from the applications page before adding the first customer, or the quote will fail.
newPage.legacyDescription: Register a customer instance from a published applications release.
newPage.customerHint: The customer name and its first administrator in the workspace.
newPage.onboardingHint: A one-time line on this first invoice only, at the fee in the billing settings. Renewals never carry it.
newPage.legacyHint: This deployment has no shared workspaces, so the customer is registered as a standalone instance of a published applications release instead of a plan.
newPage.planHint: Choose the plan the customer subscribes to and its billing cycle.

aiBillingSettings.title: AI billing settings
aiBillingSettings.hint: The AI balance customers can buy and the free AI allowances. They apply to every customer.
aiBillingSettings.saved: The AI billing settings were saved.
aiBillingSettings.pushed: {count} workspace received its new AI allowance. | {count} workspaces received their new AI allowance.

sections.topupHint: The amounts a customer may buy, the lowest amount, and the rate that turns riyals into AI balance.
sections.allowancesHint: AI usage included for every customer, expressed as a value in riyals. Changing an allowance updates the customers' workspaces.

fields.amountsHint: Separate the amounts with an Arabic comma (،) or a semicolon (;), from the smallest to the largest, for example 25; 50; 100. A Latin comma never separates amounts; it is only a thousands mark inside one, as in 1,250. Up to 12 amounts.
fields.minimumHint: Every amount offered must reach it.
fields.rateHint: Converts a top-up into AI balance, for example 3.75. Up to six decimals.

errors.amounts: Enter between 1 and 12 different amounts in riyals, with at most two decimals, from the smallest to the largest.
errors.minimum: Enter the lowest amount in riyals; every amount offered must be at least this much.
errors.rate: Enter a positive rate with at most six decimals, such as 3.75.
errors.trial: Enter an amount in riyals, or 0 for no trial allowance.
errors.monthly: Enter an amount in riyals, or 0 for no monthly allowance.

billingSettings.title: Billing settings
billingSettings.hint: The values Liwan's own billing runs on. Change them here, never in code.

sections.sellerHint: Printed on every customer invoice, copied onto each invoice when it is issued. A legal name in either language is required before it shows; the rest is optional. There is no tax number field: Liwan is not VAT-registered.
sections.bankHint: Customers see this account on an unpaid invoice. Leave the IBAN empty to stop offering bank transfer.

fields.windowHint: A full refund is allowed only for the customer's first payment and only within these days of it.
fields.ibanHint: A Saudi IBAN: SA followed by 22 digits.
fields.onboardingFeeHint: A positive whole amount charged once when a customer starts with assisted onboarding. Enter 0 to stop offering it; leave it empty to keep the current fee.

errors.sellerEmail: Enter a valid email address, or leave it empty.
errors.window: Enter a whole number of days between 0 and 365.
errors.iban: Enter a Saudi IBAN (SA and 22 digits), or leave it empty.
errors.onboardingFee: Enter a whole amount in SAR, without fractions, such as 499, or 0 to stop offering onboarding.

invoices.title: Invoices and collection
invoices.notOfficialHint: What the customer is charged for their Liwan subscription.
invoices.notAvailableHint: The invoices service is not enabled in the control plane yet.

export.failed: The export failed and no file was created. Try again.
export.capped: Only the first {cap} invoices are exported and the file name ends in -partial. Narrow the filters to export the rest.

print.title: Invoice document
print.draft: A draft invoice has no number and cannot be printed.

invoices.attemptsNone: Payment attempts are not yet attached to this invoice.

transfer.title: Bank transfer received
transfer.hint: Record a transfer you received for this invoice. The order is then paid and activated as any other payment.
transfer.confirmHint: The amount must match the invoice total, and the reference cannot be used twice.
transfer.amountHint: In riyals, with at most two decimals, such as 123.45.
transfer.amountInvalid: Enter the amount as a number in riyals, such as 123.45, with a point before the decimals and no sign or letters.
transfer.amountDecimals: A riyal amount has at most two decimals. Enter the exact amount received, without rounding.
transfer.claimed: Stated by the customer, not verified: it transferred this on {date}
transfer.claimedReference: Sender or bank reference given by the customer: {reference}

void.title: Void this renewal invoice
void.hint: Cancels this unpaid renewal invoice. Nothing was received, so no credit note is made and nothing is refunded. Choose what happens to the subscription.
void.confirmHint: This cannot be undone. The customer's card is no longer charged for it, and a payment that still arrives is refunded automatically.
void.outcomeEndHint: The workspace drops to the free base now and the renewal is cancelled. The data is kept.
void.outcomeRebillHint: The subscription stays as it is. The next renewal run issues a new invoice for the same period with a new due date.

reason.invoice_not_voidable: This is not an unpaid renewal invoice, so it cannot be voided. Reload the page and check its status.
reason.payment_reconciliation_required: A payment attempt on this order is not settled yet. Check it with the payment provider and settle it before voiding the invoice.
reason.transfer_claimed: The customer says it transferred the amount. Check the transfer and record it first; the invoice cannot be voided before that.
reason.renewal_in_progress: A paid renewal is still being applied. Wait for it to finish, then check the invoice.
reason.lock_pending: The subscription is being moved to the free base. Try again later.
reason.tenant_retiring: The workspace is being deleted, so its billing is not changed.
reason.subscription_suspended: You suspended this subscription by hand. Resume it first, or choose to bill the period again.
reason.subscription_change_pending: A paid change is still being processed on this subscription. Let it finish or cancel it first.
reason.invoice_void_retry: Another change was made to this subscription at the same moment, so nothing was voided. Reload the invoice and try again.

refund.title: Record that this credit note was refunded
refund.description: This does not refund anything. Return the money another way first (a bank transfer, or the payment provider's dashboard after checking it was not already refunded there), then record the reference here.

automatic.inProgress: The refund is being made through the payment provider. Nothing else is needed; this page shows the result.
automatic.recording: The payment provider has returned the money. The record will complete by itself; no manual refund is needed or allowed.
automatic.recordingBlocked: The record is delayed, and it is retried automatically. Last answer: {reason}
automatic.unverified: The provider has not confirmed this refund yet. Do not refund by hand.
automatic.unverifiedHint: Check the provider's dashboard. This page keeps checking the provider and records the refund when it shows the money returned. The manual form stays closed so the customer is not paid twice.
automatic.retrying: The provider has not confirmed yet. Last answer: {reason}
automatic.failed: The payment provider could not refund this payment: {reason}
automatic.failedHint: Check the provider's dashboard first so the customer is not paid twice. If the money was not returned, return it another way and record the reference below.
automatic.done: Refunded by the system through the payment provider. The reference below is the provider's.

stuck.title: Stuck refund
stuck.hint: This refund is waiting for the provider's answer or for its own record. These actions never refund money: only the system's refund worker does. Refund only through the provider, never by a bank transfer or by hand.

conflict.title: Another credit note already holds this payment id
conflict.hint: The money is back, but the provider reference is recorded on another note, so this note cannot take it unchanged.

check.outcome: Nothing was refunded or changed by this check. A refund the provider returned is recorded by the worker on its next run. A refund call made less than an hour ago is not repeated: the worker retries it only after that hour, on its own schedule.

release.confirmTitle: Release the hold on this refund
release.confirmHint: The hold lifts only when the provider's answer is definitive, and at least an hour after the refund call. A payment refunded in full is marked returned and recorded. A payment with nothing refunded goes back to the worker, which refunds it through its guarded path or hands the note to the manual form. Refund only through the provider: never refund this payment by a bank transfer or by hand.

record.confirmHint: The provider already returned this money. Choose how to close the note. Nothing is refunded again.

resolutions.record: Record the refund on this note, under the payment id and a short note id because another note holds the payment id
resolutions.already_recorded: Close this note as void: the other note on this invoice already credits this money

refund.dropsToFreeBase: This is the customer's first payment: recording the refund drops the subscription to the free base at once. Items bought with a later payment stay.
refund.referenceHint: The refund or payment id shown in the provider's dashboard.
refund.firstPayment: Refund eligibility: this is the customer's first payment.
refund.firstPaymentNo: Refund eligibility: this is not the customer's first payment.
refund.windowClosed: The {days}-day refund window has closed; this payment is no longer refundable.
refund.notFirstPayment: Only the customer's first payment is refundable; this is a later payment.
refund.alreadyRequested: A refund was already requested for this invoice. Its credit note is listed under adjustments.

request.title: Refund request
request.hint: When the customer asks for their money back inside the refund window, request the refund here. It opens a credit note for the whole invoice. A card payment is returned through the provider automatically; a bank transfer is returned by you and recorded on the note.
request.confirmTitle: Request a full refund of this invoice
request.confirmHint: This opens a credit note for the invoice total. A card payment is refunded by the system through the payment provider. A bank transfer is returned by you, then recorded on the note.
request.unitsUsedHint: Read the units this top-up has spent in the customer's workspace. Enter 0 if none were used. A top-up with any use cannot be refunded.
request.unitsUsedInvalid: Enter a whole number, 0 or more.

topup.title: Refund this AI top-up
topup.hint: This is a later payment, so the general refund request does not apply. An AI top-up that is unused and still inside the refund window can be refunded here. It opens a credit note for the whole invoice and lowers the customer's AI balance. A card payment is returned through the provider automatically; a bank transfer is returned by you and recorded on the note.
topup.confirmTitle: Refund this AI top-up in full
topup.confirmHint: This opens a credit note for the invoice total and removes the top-up from the customer's balance. A card payment is refunded by the system through the payment provider. A bank transfer is returned by you, then recorded on the note.

errors.units_used_required: Say how many AI units of this top-up were already used, then request the refund again.
errors.ai_topup_used: Part of this invoice's AI top-up was already used, so it cannot be refunded.
errors.credit_note_not_pending: This credit note is no longer pending. The page shows its current state.
errors.refund_reference_in_use: This refund reference is already recorded on another credit note.
errors.refund_window_closed: The refund window has closed, so this payment cannot be refunded.
errors.refund_not_first_payment: Only the customer's first payment can be refunded; renewals and later payments cannot.
errors.lock_pending: The subscription is still being moved to the free base. Record the refund again once that finishes.
errors.fulfillment_pending: This order is still being delivered. Request the refund once the delivery ends.
errors.refund_in_progress: The system is still refunding this payment through the provider. Wait for the result; the manual form opens only if the provider cannot refund.
errors.refund_not_stuck: This refund is no longer stuck, or this action does not apply to its state. The page shows its current state.
errors.provider_status_unverified: The provider's answer could not be read or is not for this payment, so nothing was changed. Try again later.
errors.provider_refund_unavailable: No payment provider is connected for this payment, so the control plane cannot read it.
errors.provider_refund_amount_unverified: The provider says the payment is refunded but gives no usable amount, so the hold stays.
errors.provider_refund_partial: The provider shows only part of the payment refunded. The worker keeps asking for the rest, so the hold stays.
errors.refund_attempt_too_recent: The last refund call was made less than an hour ago and may still land at the provider. Release the hold from the time shown under "Release possible from". Each time the worker repeats the refund call, that time moves an hour on.
errors.refund_attempt_unavailable: The order of this payment has moved on, so the refund cannot be checked or recorded from here.
errors.refund_over_credit: Recording this note would credit more than the invoice's payment. Close it as already recorded instead, if another note credits this money.
errors.refund_not_duplicate: The note that holds the payment id is not on this invoice, is not settled, is a duplicate-payment note, is in another currency, or covers less than this note, so this note cannot be closed as a duplicate.
errors.refund_note_unavailable: This credit note is not the pending note of the invoice that was paid, so nothing was recorded.
errors.ai_topup_refund_mixed_order: This invoice charged more than the AI top-up, so the top-up cannot be refunded on its own.

switchForm.title: Discard what you typed?
switchForm.hint: Another form on this invoice is open with text you have not sent. Opening this one closes it and the text is lost.

invoices.immutable: An issued invoice is never edited; corrections are separate documents.
